connector.name: Arca
connector.registryDescription: Arca is a private data vault where your AI stores your structured data, semantic memory and skills.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.arca.build over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace build.arca.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
